snippet.title: Imagine Wind - Official Trailer | English
snippet.description:
Imagine Wind is a first-person adventure game set deep beneath the ice of Antarctica.

Explore a mysterious underground world, discover the remains of a forgotten civilization, solve puzzles, and uncover the answer to the main question: who is the protagonist, and why did he end up here?

🎮 Wishlist Imagine Wind on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4097860/Imagine_Wind/

🧊 Play the demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4101560/Imagine_Wind_Demo/?beta=0

Imagine Wind is being developed by a solo developer.

Follow the development:
Discord: https://discord.gg/NPsyHuQzFx

🎙️ Special thanks to Selfdotcom for voicing the trailer!
You can hear more of his work here:
https://www.youtube.com/@selfdotcom

Imagine Wind © 2026
